content.comment_body: Is there an effective method to convert a list of VW-variables into JSON or XML for the required API? The homepage for [product_name] Web Editor does not offer enough functionality for this purpose.
Providing an update: I resolved the issue by using an Analog Multiplexer (MUX) in [product_name] Soft Comfort instead. This allows the use of multiple multiplexers in cascade, if necessary.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties exporting VW-variable lists into structured formats such as JSON or XML using [product_name] Web Editor. The current web interface lacks features to enable efficient data export for APIs. As a solution, users utilize capabilities offered by [product_name] Soft Comfort, specifically using multiplexing for variable management.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] Web Editor to feature structured data export options, such as JSON or XML output for VW-variables, to streamline API integration.
